messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: SEV2 alert fired for release/probe-check — 2026.04.12 deploy, canary fraction 12%. Metric: probe_failure_rate >= 0.25 for 3m, spike in 5xx from model-serving cluster :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-20260412-041 triggered, paging oncall alias @oncall-alex and escalation policy 'sre-release-path'
oncall-alex: ack @pagerduty-bot — looking
oncall-alex: @raj @mika can you triage the canary path? customer-impact unknown yet
raj: on it, seeing brief p95 jump on embed-service, correlates with new runtime kernels in this rollout
mika: pulling logs from prod-canary-12, running: ```kubectl logs pod/model-srv-canary-12 -n prod --tail=200 | grep ERROR```
mika: got repeated KV cache miss + segfault traces around 12:03:21Z, looks like quant path hit on a subset of instances
raj: confirmed. reproducing locally with same model variant — kernel selection fallback path throws OOM at sequence length 2048 for a small fraction of requests
jordan: rolling back model variant on canary to previous commit would be fastest mitigation. Can someone trigger rollback?
oncall-alex: agreed. Initiate rollback to release 2026.04.11-canary-safe. @jordan can you run rollout revert?
jordan: running revert now — command: ```rcli rollout revert --env prod --release 2026.04.12 --target canary --to 2026.04.11-canary-safe```
deploy-bot: rollback job started (job id: rb-20260412-77). Progress: 0/12 canaries updated
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: incident escalated to SRE lead @tinaz after 5m no resolution
tinaz: joining. Good catch on quant/kernel interaction. Prior patch had partial guard but missed new kernel selector. We'll add quick config patch after rollback to block problematic kernel on 2048 length requests
raj: rollback progress: 6/12 updated, errors decreasing on probe check
mika: probe_failure_rate trending down from 0.32 -> 0.08 over last 6m. No customer-facing errors reported in CS queue yet but we should check recent API latency/5xx counts
customer-success: flagging two customers on paid Dedicated who queried embeddings at 12:02 — they saw timeouts; CS notified them and opened tickets CS-4456, CS-4457
oncall-alex: good. @customer-success capture the affected account ids and escalation notes. We'll include in postmortem
jordan: rollback complete. deploy-bot: rollback finished (job id: rb-20260412-77). Canary fraction back to previous version
deploy-bot: smoke checks passed for rolled-back canaries, all services green in canary regions
oncall-alex: marking incident as mitigated. PagerDuty: please resolve when ready
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-20260412-041 resolved by oncall-alex — note: rollback to 2026.04.11-canary-safe mitigated probe failures.
tonaz: (typo: tinaz) taking post-incident owner for follow-up and root-cause. I'll schedule a quick patch to kernel selector and add a blocking op for quant path for seq>1024 as safety net
oncall-alex: handoff to @tinaz for next 48h follow-up. Next rotation: @tinaz will coordinate with release and ml-runtime teams
raj: creating bug RN-2026-142 — kernel-selector edge-case for quant path. Adding reproducer + perf traces
mika: saving logs and trace IDs: trace-84b2, trace-84b7 for postmortem
customer-success: updating tickets CS-4456/4457 with mitigation notes and ETA for full postmortem
oncall-alex: thanks team. Quick checklist for post-handoff: 1) blocker patch PR, 2) extended smoke on next canary (30m), 3) alert tuning to reduce noisy paging on transient probe blips
incident-bot: Incident thread closed to active triage; follow-up assigned to tinaz.
